rationale: Document 16 section 14.5: an ArtifactRef points to an immutable object/version/hash, 'never a raw storage key'. That clause is discharged by pinned-version-ref:1's unevaluatedProperties:false rather than by any member typed-refs:1 writes, so this fixture is what proves the clause is enforced at all: an expiring signed URL smuggled in beside the pin is refused, not merely discouraged.
